title: Aces of the Luftwaffe
notes: Reviewed community evidence; not a complete playthrough verification.

reviewedUserReports.notes: Physical ARM64 smoke test on 2026-10-10 with the exact IPA, POCO M2007J20CG (Android 12, Adreno 618), Super Duper Debug tree f8d2fecb. Splash and resource load complete; chapter, pilot and upgrade selections respond to 320-450 ms holds or swipes, and mission 1 Battle of Britain renders and continues for the bounded observation. The screenshot is from that live mission. Short menu taps did not always register. In-mission steering/fire, acoustic audio, pause/exit, saves, mission completion and long-session stability were not accepted. This is partial compatibility only, not a full-playthrough claim.
